intro: Meet Forge Agent: a coding agent that lives in VS Code, and runs its loop on TrueForge.
arch: Under the hood, the extension is a TrueForge client. TrueForge runs the agent loop; the editor serves context, files, edits and the terminal as MCP tools. And every edit waits for your review.
overview: Three fixed tasks on Flask. Every model call, edit and test here is live; only the clicks are scripted.
a_inst: Select get debug flag, press Control Alt E, and describe the change.
a_ff: Gemini 3.5 Flash reads the file through TrueForge, and proposes an edit.
a_rev: The diff opens right in the editor. Two hunks, accepted one at a time, then applied. Until then, nothing is written.
a_ver: Now we verify. Off, n and zero are false. One and yes stay true. All thirty-five helper tests pass.
b_inst: This is the official instruction, with no file names. The agent has to find the code, the tests and the docs by itself.
b_ctx: First, context assembly: a budgeted ranking with BM25 and the import graph. Every pick shows why it was chosen.
b_ff: Gemini Flash-Lite plans with a task ledger, and reads only what it needs.
b_rev1: Each edit pauses the TrueForge turn for review. First, cli dot py: three hunks, accepted one by one.
b_rev3: and the docs, next to the other built-in commands.
b_more: Five reviews. Three files. All found without being told.
b_sess: And here is the same run inside TrueForge: every turn, and every tool call.
b_retry: A 503 from the provider? The run recovers on its own, with a recovery turn.
b_defer: Rarely used tools stay deferred. The agent lists them, inspects one, then calls it through TrueForge.
b_cfg: Flask config shows up in the help, and the real command prints every secret, token and password as stars.
b_undo: One click on Undo Agent Run reverts all three files. Clean.
x_cancel: We cancel while its diff is waiting for review. Unapplied edits are discarded,
c_set: The first model in the list now points at a dead endpoint.
c_inst: Same inline edit as Task A.
c_fb: The endpoint is unreachable, so Forge falls back to Flash-Lite automatically, and tells you in the panel.
c_again: Rejected again, and the run is cancelled.
c_clean: No files changed. Git status: clean.
outro: Forge Agent, on TrueForge. Built by team StarDust, for the Techfest Forge-a-thon.
